message: You know, I always thought it would be kind of funny to turn my living room into a swimming pool during a storm. But then I remembered those soggy socks and the smell of wet dog—definitely not the vibe I’m going for! 🌧️ If you’re like me and have a knack for unexpected home renovations (thanks, weather), it might be a good idea to check out some resources on flood preparedness. After all, a little planning can save you from an impromptu swim! Have you ever found yourself unprepared for a storm?
